title: defer and guaranteed scope cleanup
summary: Restore a temporary flag with defer on both the success path and an early return.
triggers: temporary state must be restored whenever a scope exits
prompts: Clear an import-in-progress flag even when validation returns early.
invariant: The synchronous run method leaves isBusy false before returning.
mantra: Set up; register cleanup; do the work.
pitfalls: defer executes when its scope exits, not where it is declared.
This synchronous class is not a synchronization primitive for concurrent access.
